requirement.statement: cozo-wiki SHALL bound inferred documentation-to-symbol relations during repository indexing.

case.given: A repository has many markdown doc blocks and many code symbols with repeated common names
case.when: The repository indexer builds CodeKnowledge relations with default options
case.then: The indexer SHALL NOT scan every doc block against every symbol as persisted relations
case.and: The generated documents relations SHALL remain bounded by per-doc and total relation budgets

case.given: A markdown file documents a symbol in the same file neighborhood
case.when: The repository indexer builds CodeKnowledge relations with default options
case.then: The indexer SHALL persist a documents relation for that local high-confidence match

case.given: A caller explicitly configures doc-symbol link mode or max relations
case.when: The index_repo tool or RepositoryIndexer receives those options
case.then: The indexer SHALL apply the requested mode and budgets deterministically
